<MethodEndpoint

  path={"/csv/sync"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>

Starts parsing/ingestion for the given uploadIds as a single `csv`-kind sync. Creates one sync row that groups the batch (poll via `GET /sync/{syncId}`) and links every upload to it. Only files in `uploaded` status are accepted — re-triggering already-processed files is rejected to avoid duplicate ingestion. Files handed to `POST /csv/ai-convert` are refused (400 `UPLOAD_NOT_CONVERTED`) until that conversion completes.
